meta.name: pua-flavor
meta.description: PUA flavor alias for Codex. Codex subcommand mapping for Claude Code /pua:flavor style usage; invoke with $pua-flavor.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果喜欢用幽默别名操作Codex命令
copy.tagline_en: Invoke Codex commands with PUA-style aliases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you enjoy using humorous aliases for Codex commands

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取 flavor 参考，帮助用户选择或设置 flavor 到 ~/.pua/config.json，且不覆盖其他字段。
howto.when: 当用户通过 Claude Code 输入 /pua:flavor 命令或调用 $pua-flavor 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置一个 PUA flavor。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择 flavor 并写入配置。

say.text: 查看当前 flavor 配置。

say.note: Claude 会更新配置中的 flavor 字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the flavor reference and helps the user choose or set a flavor in ~/.pua/config.json without overwriting unrelated fields.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user enters the /pua:flavor command or calls $pua-flavor in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Help me set a PUA flavor.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to choose a flavor and write it to config.
Claude will read ~/.pua/config.json and display it.
Claude will update the flavor field in config.
